note: Both sets focus on the Cooking water-weight thresholds and the 96.00 oz starting-water minimum, and both are heavily redundant, but Set A keeps the inequality directions (≥ 80 oz, ≤ 16 oz, 450 < W < 2300 g) exactly as stated in Figure 9 and the rule text. Set B drops the inequalities (e.g. '16 oz' and '2300 g' as bare thresholds, '16 to 80 oz' for a strictly bounded range) and misstates the single-container condition as 'vaporized in a single task'. Neither set captures the body-text full-points requirement of 5.000 lb (80.00 oz or 2.268 kg) vaporized, but Set A is otherwise fully supported and better bound.
